description:
The compact hints show '! bash' implying that typing '! <cmd>' runs a shell command. The expanded banner confirms: '!  run bash command'.

Actually handle_submit/3 in interactive.ex sends all input directly to OctoPi.Agent.prompt/2 with no prefix handling. '! echo hello' is sent verbatim to the AI as a prompt.

Upstream pi intercepts '!'-prefixed input, runs the command in a shell, and streams the output into the transcript as a bash execution block (using the existing BashExecution component).

Needs: prefix detection in handle_submit + shell execution + transcript entry.
title: ! bash passthrough not implemented — shell commands sent to AI instead
